name: Camp Clark
description_short: YMCA day camp on Hyles Pond in Plymouth, run in weekly themed sessions. Campers swim twice a day, go boating, try archery, crafts, sports and a ropes course, and explore the woods and pond.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim in Hyles Pond during two free swim periods a day, watched by certified lifeguards. The waterfront also has boating and a Wibit water obstacle course.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Weeks are listed without a year; they match the 2026 calendar (Monday starts, no camp Friday July 3) and the page links the 2026 camp brochure. Week 1 (June 15 to 19) was canceled and Week 11 added. No bus in weeks 2 and 11. Price is the FAQ figure: a traditional week costs as low as $345 for members and $415 for non members, with extra charges for specialty camps, before or after care and transportation. Bus routes run for a fee. Lunch is free of charge for campers this summer. Income based two week camperships for Basic Day Camp. Basic Day Camp wording gives camp_type day.

warnings: The page lists weeks without a year. They fit 2026 only, and the linked brochure is the 2026 brochure, so season_year is 2026. No 2027 dates are posted.
The price is an 'as low as' figure from the FAQ, which says pricing is updated yearly; per session prices are not given.
Plymouth is about 40 miles from Boston, on the South Shore.
